The log has no timers for any of these.\n\n## The seam\n- **File and function:** `scripts/evaluate_siglip2_identity_diversity.py`, `exit_rehash`, lines 2089\u20132090.\n- **Current code:** a serial `for p,h in context['guards'].items(): bound_file({},p,h)` over the 20,302 receipt guards. The duplicate processor call at `images_outputs` is a deliberate independent pixel check, so it must stay.\n\n## Estimate\n- **Evaluator-owned loop (X):** at least 15.7 s, the measured `own_union` population, which is a subset. At most about 35 s.\n- **Saving:** 4 workers should give 2\u20133.5\u00d7 on that loop, so roughly **8\u201325 s, central about 15 s (ESTIMATE)**. That is also more headroom against the 900 s cap, where control finished at 670.7 s.\n\n## Falsifier and gates\n1. **CPU-only A/B, after active job 85783 exits.** It must not run during it, because I/O contention would perturb its cap.\n   - **Setup:** use the receipt's `input_guards`. Alternate three times between serial `bound_file({},\u2026)` and `batch_bound_files({},\u2026)`.\n   - **Result:** the serial wall time is the measured X, which closes the attribution gap.\n   - **Gates:** continue only if X \u2265 25 s and the 4-worker run is \u2264 0.6\u00d7 the serial run. The receipt must be identical to control except for timing, wall and invocation fields: the same 20,302 guard keys, `outputs_sha256`, `ordered_images_sha256`, panel facts, RNG and flags. Host peak must stay \u2264 5.2 GB and CUDA peak \u2264 2.07 GB.\n3. **Quality gate:** none. `quality_read` stays False and the math is untouched.\n4. **Freeze caveat:** this edits a pinned evaluator file, so it needs a new execution pin and a new launch binding, never a silent change.
